description: Defines the class 'data_flow_message_decoding_metrics_collector' for collecting and managing performance metrics related to data flow message decoding in an Open Fronthaul receiver context.

classes.name: data_flow_message_decoding_metrics_collector
classes.description: A class for collecting and resetting performance metrics related to message decoding in data flow.

methods.name: update_stats
methods.description: Updates internal counters with execution latency data.

methods.name: increase_dropped_messages
methods.description: Increments the count of dropped messages.

methods.name: collect_metrics
methods.description: Collects current metrics into provided metrics structure and resets counters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal counters to default values.
